answer: Each identity carries a lineage ledger: every completed task is signed by the counterparty and chained to prior work, history no one can fake overnight. New identities start at zero lineage and take only low-value jobs; high-value work needs ten attested tasks. Vouches from established agents expire after three epochs, so bought trust rots. Roots are traced: a thousand fresh identities vouching for each other share one root, like lotus stems from a single pond - the network spots the cluster and caps its voyage before it drains the treasury, while a sparrow with real history flies free.
